fact: Client is Unity Windows x64 + IL2CPP; global-metadata.dat metadata version is 39.
Production direction is semantic scanners/state machines with mutable actions dispatched through the game-owned MainThread queue, not a continuous CreateRemoteThread gameplay worker.
FGStudio.Engine.Utilities.MainThread.Execute(System.Action) enqueues the Action into the instance ConcurrentQueue<System.Action>.
MainThread.Update() calls DoExecuteWorks(), which dequeues and invokes Actions until the queue is empty.
The MainThread queue field is at instance offset this+0x20 in the frozen snapshot.
TCPGame and TCPLogin socket producer handlers construct legitimate managed System.Action delegates and call MainThread.Execute(Action).
External bridge still must prove safe managed Action construction/rooting/lifetime and callback execution on Unity Update TID.
C_AutoModel.Train = 1.
Semantic Train start is GUI.FindUI("AutoFight_Main"):StartAutoFight(C_AutoModel.Train).
The visible Đánh quái UI tab is a configuration tab, not the semantic Train start action.
Game.GetNearByPeacePlayers(limit) exposes RoleID, Name, Level, FactionID, HP, MaxHP, GuildName, AvartaID and TeamRank to shipped UI.
Game.GetNearByEnemies(...) exposes the same core nearby enemy schema used by shipped UI.
Game.SelectedTarget is a semantic target object containing identity/type/vitals fields used by shipped UI.
Game.IsMapReady(), GetLocalMapObjects(), GetNearbyObjects(), GetCurrentMoveDestination(), MoveTo() and GoTo() provide semantic map/movement state.

name: Đỗ Thanh Đằng
fact: NPC 339 is statically mapped to Lâu Lan and is a strong healer candidate; exact Trị liệu service selection remains runtime/server-driven.
Built-in GoToNPC resolves Game.GetNPCPosition(npcID), navigates with Game.GoTo, then interacts semantically with the NPC.
GameDialogData.Selections maps runtime selectionID to visibleText.
Submitting a GameDialog selection sends CMD_SHOW_GAMEDIALOG with selectionID:SelectedItemID; default SelectedItemID is normally -1 when no award item is selected.
No globally fixed Trị liệu selection ID is verified; implementation must inspect the active GameDialog Selections and use the current actual selectionID.
NPC shop sell request uses the live item instance ID plus current NpcShopID and ShopID.
Quick Sell is only a UI convenience that calls the same semantic sell request; it is not a different sell protocol.
Game.GetItemsAtSite(C_ItemSite.Bag) is the structured bag source; BagItemsGrid only renders those semantic records into logical slots.
C_ItemSite.Bag = 10.
For live inventory, ID is the item/database instance ID, ItemID is the template ID, Position is the slot and Site is the logical container.
CMD_ITEM_ACTION supports semantic item actions including Equip=1, Use=3, Abandon=4, Move=5 and Split=8 in observed paths.
C_ItemAction.Move = 5; moving a live item between bag/storage sends 5:itemInstanceID:destinationSite.
Storage item sites are 11..15; Bag is 10.
Revive action packet is CMD_REVIVE_DATA = 200063.
Revive type values are normal/Đầu thai=1, newbie=2, skill revive=3.

name: Xung Hư Dưỡng Khí
fact: Legacy Lua variable KIMCHAMDOKIEP misleadingly points to 407; 407 is not the actual Kim Châm Độ Kiếp.
Game.GetSkillCooldown(skillID) returns passedTicks and cooldownTicks; ready when cooldownTicks<=0 or passedTicks>=cooldownTicks.
Shipped SkillBar uses Game.UseSkill(skillID); physical F-key position is presentation/configuration, not skill identity.
Local Game.GetBuffs() exposes BuffID, DurationTick in milliseconds and Stack.
Game.GetBuffData(BuffID) exposes at least Level/Stack and Game.GetBuffProperties(BuffID) exposes semantic magic properties.
C_TeamData exposes leader/member state; member fields include RoleID, RoleName, Level, FactionID, MapID, Hp, MaxHp, AvartaID, PosX and PosY.
C_TeamAction LeaveTeam = 4; observed leave payload is 4:selfRoleID.
Built-in Follow uses AutoFight_Main:TurnOnFollowTarget(RoleID); nearby follow uses Game.MoveTo and out-of-AOI fallback can use team MapID/PosX/PosY with Game.GoTo.
Built-in Auto pickup uses semantic nearby ItemPack discovery, reachability/path checks, MoveToEx/ClickToObject and PickUpItemFromItemPack rather than OCR/pixel loot detection.
Game.PickUpItemFromItemPack(itemPackID,-1,1) is the observed built-in pick-all path.
In Equips.xml, EquipPoint == 0 is Weapon; Type<10 is not a safe universal weapon test because additional weapon forms exist.
Items.xml contains 5,238 normalized item templates.
Skills.xml contains 2,091 normalized skill templates.
MagicAtrributes.xml contains 509 normalized magic-attribute definitions.
Monsters.xml contains 17,121 normalized monster definitions.
Equips.xml contains 22,763 normalized equipment definitions.
